subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ34 across its XF X250, XK X150 applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ34 is fitted to the XF and XK models, with the XK being the more common application we see in the workshop.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Timing chain, bearings, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild, with additional inspection of the VVT system, cooling system, and intake manifold components.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: The AJ34 is known for VVT phase regulator unreliability, cooling system concerns (the aluminium engine is sensitive to overheating), PCV valve clogging leading to high oil consumption, and intake manifold swirl flap degradation on higher-mileage vehicles. Ignition coil pack failure and thermostat housing coolant leaks are also common.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ34 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ34 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ34's VVT system is a known critical point, and the VVT phase regulators are inspected thoroughly on every rebuild. The aluminium engine is sensitive to overheating, so the cooling system (water pump, hoses, and thermostat housing) receives particular attention during strip-down. PCV valve clogging is a known cause of high oil consumption on higher-mileage examples, so the PCV system is always checked. The intake manifold swirl flaps are also inspected for degradation. Ignition coil pack failure is common, so these are checked as part of the electrical system inspection.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, VVT system inspection, cooling system inspection, PCV system check, swirl flap inspection, ignition coil check.

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
